exposure.needed: whether the cluster has CRDs newer than the installed Istio release, so that resources exist at API versions istiod does not know about

consequence.statement: The validation webhook now accepts resources at CRD versions it does not know about instead of not accepting them, so an older Istio can validate resources created by newer CRDs.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; if running an older Istio against newer CRDs, verify resources at unknown versions are admitted as expected.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24 changes Istiod's validation webhook to accept CRD versions it does not know about, so that an older Istio can validate resources created by newer CRDs.
